data.explanation: This is a bill for an online purchase (Kauf auf Rechnung). Transfer €134.98 to the IBAN shown in the letter and put the invoice number BV-7741203 as the payment reference. The payment period is 7 days from the invoice date, so the app shows the exact due date. If you don't pay in time, the seller may send a reminder (Mahnung) and add fees. Keep the invoice as proof of purchase.
